name: hing_hfd_B_div3
purpose: HBM die GPU-prefill KV-ingest master hfd_host_ingest (ot_rom_host_ingest ROWS/RAW + ot_hbm_ingest_xlat -> dskv_wb decode layout on the stack wq port, completion fence on the write ACKs): B aggressive margin: clk_i ck/3 (12.8 GB/s >= the 9.8 GB/s 1M burst), util 35 % | APPROVED by the reviewer (RQ-ING-5, REVIEW_20261008 addendum). 0 token-path cycles (off the decode path).

bench.name: hhing_exact_fence
bench.cmd: python3 tools/rtl_hbm_host_ingest_bench.py --work /tmp/hhing_{NAME} --output {RUN}/bench/hbm_ingest.json > {RUN}/bench.txt 2>&1; grep -q '^pass: True' {RUN}/bench.txt && echo HHING_PASS

bench.name: hhing_neg
bench.cmd: grep -q 'mutant window_ring_slot_plus_one detected' {RUN}/bench.txt && grep -q 'mutant completion_fence_removed detected' {RUN}/bench.txt && echo HHING_NEG_FAIL && exit 1; exit 0

calibrate.reason: new master, no die generator ports yet: block-internal closure at the generic 20 % IO first (die-face budget after placement in r21c / S81 r5)

route.cmd: export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl'; SRC="{SRC}" OUT="{RUN}/routes" DIV="3" UTIL="35" PD="0.5" HM="0.01" NEED="24" XSRCS="rtl/hdc/ingest/ot_hbm_ingest_xlat.sv" bash physical/rom_host_ingest/route.sh {LABEL} hfd_host_ingest
